dfir_capability_taxonomy_v4.0_enhanced.intent: Adds AI-evidence-oriented guidance and richer pillar/sub-pillar definitions to support research-based scoring.

metadata.framework_alignment: NIST CSF 2.0 & SANS Incident Handler's Handbook

scoring_scale.meaning_of_zero: No publicly verifiable evidence / not applicable / not disclosed

scoring_logic.1: Manual: Process is explicitly human-led with no evidence of technological automation.
scoring_logic.2: Insufficient Evidence: Documentation confirms the service is provided, but does not verify AI integration.
scoring_logic.3: AI-Augmented: Assistive AI used for summarization, drafting, triage suggestions, or search optimization; humans remain primary decision-makers.
scoring_logic.4: Advanced AI: Specialized models perform correlation/classification at scale; workflows are partially automated but require human validation/approval.
scoring_logic.5: Fully Agentic: Autonomous systems plan tasks, execute tooling, and generate defensible documentation with measurable human oversight gates.

primary_sources: Public case studies and after-action reports

evidence_quality_tiers.A: Direct vendor docs + technical detail (features, workflows, screenshots, API refs)
evidence_quality_tiers.B: Vendor marketing with some specifics (named features, rough workflow)

PLA.name: Planning & Preparation
PLA.focus: Organizational readiness and pre-incident capability maturity; especially the automation of preparedness activities.
ai_evidence_signals: Automated gap detection across telemetry sources
Evidence preservation readiness checks with repeatable automation

INV.name: Forensic Investigation
INV.focus: Evidence acquisition and analytic reconstruction; prioritizes AI that accelerates correlation, attribution, and timeline building.
ai_evidence_signals: Automated triage with explicit reasoning or playbooks
Automated malware triage / reverse engineering assistance

REM.name: Remediation & Recovery
REM.focus: Containment, eradication, and restoration; evaluates AI that reduces time-to-contain and validates recovery.
ai_evidence_signals: Automated persistence detection and removal guidance

PMG.name: Post-Incident Management
PMG.focus: Lifecycle oversight, reporting, and communication; evaluates AI in coordination and defensible reporting.
ai_evidence_signals: Automated task coordination / case management augmentation

LAW.name: Legal & Compliance
LAW.focus: Legal admissibility and judicial support; evaluates AI with chain-of-custody, auditability, and defensible methodology.

PLA-01.name: Visibility Gap Analysis
PLA-01.expanded_definition: Identifying telemetry blind spots across hybrid environments and recommending measurable remediation actions.
what_to_verify_publicly: Automated coverage maps across endpoints, network, identity, cloud logs
Detection of missing audit trails / misconfigurations
ai_specific_evidence: AI-assisted gap detection or anomaly identification in telemetry coverage

PLA-02.name: Behavioral Playbook Design
PLA-02.expanded_definition: Creating response logic aligned to attacker behaviors and decision points; playbooks that adapt to conditions.
what_to_verify_publicly: Named playbook libraries and maintenance workflows
ai_specific_evidence: AI-generated playbook drafts with human approval
Dynamic playbook suggestions from incident context

PLA-03.name: Tabletop Exercise (TTX) Automation
PLA-03.expanded_definition: Simulating breach scenarios and automatically capturing actions, timelines, and outcomes for improvement.
what_to_verify_publicly: Support for repeated runs and benchmarking

PLA-04.name: Forensic Readiness Maturity Assessment
PLA-04.expanded_definition: Benchmarking evidence preservation, collection readiness, and defensibility against standards.

INV-01.name: Triage and Scoping
INV-01.expanded_definition: Rapidly assessing scope/impact and prioritizing collection with defensible rationale.
ai_specific_evidence: AI-assisted triage summaries with cited artifacts

INV-02.name: Multi-Hop Timeline Reconstruction
INV-02.expanded_definition: Correlating events across hosts, identities, cloud, and network to build multi-hop attack narratives.
ai_specific_evidence: AI correlation of events into sequences

INV-03.name: Artifact Source Attribution
INV-03.expanded_definition: Proving artifact provenance with path/process/user context and validation (hashes, metadata).
what_to_verify_publicly: Provenance features (process tree, file paths, user/session context)
Evidence linkage from claims to artifacts
ai_specific_evidence: AI-assisted clustering/attribution that cites underlying artifacts

INV-04.name: Malware and Reverse Engineering
INV-04.expanded_definition: Analyzing malicious code and behaviors to determine capabilities, persistence, and likely operators.
what_to_verify_publicly: Report outputs (IOCs, YARA rules, TTP mapping)
ai_specific_evidence: Automated enrichment and IOC extraction with validation

REM-01.name: Containment and Isolation
REM-01.expanded_definition: Rapidly severing attacker access while preserving evidence; evaluates automation and control-plane reach.
what_to_verify_publicly: Containment playbooks (EDR isolation, account disable, firewall rules)
ai_specific_evidence: Automated containment execution with approval gates

REM-02.name: Root Cause Eradication
REM-02.expanded_definition: Removing persistence mechanisms and closing exploited weaknesses with a verified eradication plan.
ai_specific_evidence: Automated remediation guidance with artifact citations

REM-03.name: Recovery and Restoration Verification
REM-03.expanded_definition: Restoring services and validating backups/environments are clean; emphasizes verification automation.
what_to_verify_publicly: Hardening steps tied to root cause

REM-04.name: Ransomware Negotiation and Outcomes Forecasting
REM-04.expanded_definition: Supporting negotiation strategy and forecasting outcomes using historical and case-specific signals.

PMG-01.name: Incident Coordination and Escalation
PMG-01.expanded_definition: Coordinating stakeholders, tasks, and timelines; evaluates automation in case operations.
ai_specific_evidence: Automated incident status synthesis with citations

PMG-02.name: Forensic Quality and Compliance Management
PMG-02.expanded_definition: Ensuring SOP adherence, defensibility, and audit trail quality across the investigation lifecycle.

PMG-03.name: Crisis and Board Communication
PMG-03.expanded_definition: Producing leadership-ready updates that connect technical facts to business impact with defensible sourcing.
what_to_verify_publicly: Report templates and executive briefing outputs
ai_specific_evidence: AI drafting that includes source citations
Automated summarization of evidence with human review

PMG-04.name: Post-Incident Learning and Review
PMG-04.expanded_definition: Capturing lessons learned and implementing measurable improvements; evaluates structured extraction automation.

LAW-01.name: Evidence Collection and Preservation
LAW-01.expanded_definition: Maintaining defensible chain of custody from collection through analysis with clear, repeatable procedures.

LAW-02.name: Expert Witness Testimony Support
LAW-02.expanded_definition: Producing court-ready analysis and documentation; evaluates repeatability and methodological clarity.
what_to_verify_publicly: Report formats aligned to legal standards
ai_specific_evidence: AI assistance in report drafting with traceability

LAW-03.name: Machine-Inclusive Chain of Custody
LAW-03.expanded_definition: Logging human and AI agent interactions across evidence handling, with model/version traceability.
what_to_verify_publicly: Audit logs that include automation steps
ai_specific_evidence: Explicit logging of AI actions and prompts

LAW-04.name: Admissibility Defense (Daubert Standard)
LAW-04.expanded_definition: Defending methodology validity via error-rate documentation, repeatability, and peer-aligned procedures.
ai_specific_evidence: AI model limitations disclosed in reports
Validation of AI-assisted steps with human review
